descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologia informației și servicii informatice
We are looking for an experienced Senior Java Developer with strong backend development skills and German language proficiency to join our client's international development team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in Java-based applications, microservices architecture, and modern software development practices.
 Responsibilities 
Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications using Java.
Build and maintain microservices-based architectures.
Develop RESTful APIs and integrate third-party services.
Work with Spring Boot and related Java frameworks.
Design and optimize database structures and queries.
Ensure application performance, reliability, security, and scalability.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to architectural decisions.
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.
Collaborate with international teams, business stakeholders, and other developers.
Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and technical discussions.
Communicate with German-speaking stakeholders and team members.
 Requirements 
5+ years of professional experience in Java development.
Strong knowledge of Java (Java 11 or newer).
Extensive experience with Spring Boot and Spring Framework.
Solid understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems.
Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs.
Good knowledge of SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, or similar).
Experience with ORM frameworks such as Hibernate or JPA.
Familiarity with messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.
Experience with Git, Maven or Gradle, and CI/CD pipelines.
Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes is an advantage.
Understanding of software design patterns, SOLID principles, and clean code practices.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
 German language proficiency at B2/C1 level. 
Good command of English.
 Nice to Have 
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Knowledge of Kubernetes and container orchestration.
Experience with automated testing frameworks such as JUnit and Mockito.
Familiarity with event-driven architectures.
Experience with frontend technologies such as Angular or React.
Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code and DevOps practices.
